errors.evidence: The description only lists 14 of the 24 categories shown on the x-axis, making it incomplete.
The chart label is “程度重” (Degree heavy), not “程度量级” (Degree magnitude).
The chart label is “声音” (Sound), not “音高” (Pitch).
The chart label is “频次” (Frequency), not “频次频” (Frequency-freq).
The chart label is “相对” (Relative), not “相对向性” (Relative directionality).
The chart label is “光彩” (Luster), not “光锐光彩” (Sharp luster).
This label does not exist on the chart. The bar with a value of approximately 67 corresponds to the label “样态” (Manner/State).
The chart label is “负面评价” (Negative evaluation), not “负面性价” (Negative value-for-money).
The chart label is “中性状态” (Neutral state), not “中面性态” (Middle-face state).
The chart label is “负面状态”, not “负面性态”. The character is different.
The categories listed in the description are not in the same order as they appear on the chart's x-axis. For example, it lists "负面情绪" then "正面性格", but on the chart, "正面性格" comes before "负面情绪".
The vertical axis has no label in the figure. The description hallucinates the label “程度级别” (Degree Level).

errors.text_span: 其他类别柱状图的高度在 10 到 56 之间。
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. Several bars are higher than 56 (e.g., “负面状态” at ~64, “正面状态” at ~60), and many bars are lower than 10 (e.g., “程度轻” at ~4, “频次” at ~2, “声音” at ~7).

errors.evidence: The statement claims there is no "轮廓" (outline/contour), but the bars in the chart clearly have black outlines.
